note: avg_quality_loss stays <= 0 across the ENTIRE threshold range on this dataset -- even always-route-to-small doesn't hurt average judge-scored quality, and p90 is flat too (judge scores are integers 1-10, so percentiles snap to discrete values). This is a real, reportable finding tied to Phase 1's generous SCORE_GAP_THRESHOLD=1 label rule and judge scores clustering high (see Phase 1 results). The recommendation above is therefore based on the worst single-query (max) quality loss instead, which moves meaningfully across the curve (7 -> 3 points as the threshold tightens) -- the router's real value here is cutting tail-risk, not improving the average.
